summary: Verified R2 storage migration end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (13/13) passing including new R2-specific assertions: audio_key present (prefix 'shitpost-studio/jobs/'), no legacy audio_path, GET /api/jobs/{id}/audio returns 307 to *.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, output_key set after render (ends with /output.mp4), GET /api/jobs/{id}/download 307 -> R2 presigned URL, and downloaded MP4 begins with valid bytes. Frontend regression via Playwright: upload sample_short.mp3 -> mode Shitpost -> Analiz Et -> editor loaded, audio src resolves to /api/jobs/{id}/audio (redirects to R2), play-toggle worked, render-button -> render-overlay -> final-video and download-button appear; download href points to /api/jobs/{id}/download and manual fetch returns opaqueredirect (307).
critical_code_review_comments: storage_s3.py: client cache is module-level (_client_cache) and not thread-safe; boto3 clients are thread-safe for reads but concurrent first-init could create multiple clients — low risk, cosmetic.

worker._scratch still creates pod-local dir /app/backend/storage/{job_id}/ for ffmpeg scratch (input audio + rendered output.mp4 pre-upload). This is expected transient scratch per the review request; no cleanup routine deletes it after upload — over time pod disk will grow. Consider shutil.rmtree(job_dir) after successful upload in render_job.
server.py still creates STORAGE dir on boot even though not used for job artifacts anymore — dead code, safe to remove.
presigned_url expiry is 3600s; audio element in browser may outlive it during very long editor sessions and error on replay (minor).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added test_audio_redirect_is_r2 + R2 assertions in test_job_processes_to_ready and test_render)
context_for_next_testing_agent: R2 migration verified. Backend endpoints /jobs/{id}/audio and /jobs/{id}/download return 307 with Location containing r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Full pipeline runs ~40-60s including render. Transient scratch dir /app/backend/storage/{job_id}/ still created for ffmpeg (expected) but not cleaned up post-upload.
